class Solve6:
    def solve(self):
        import sys
        input_line = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
        c = list(input_line)
        l = 0
        r = 0
        ans = 0
        while l < len(c):
            while r < len(c) and c[r] == c[l]:
                r += 1
            if (r - l) % 2 == 0:
                ans += 1
            l = r
        print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solver = Solve6()
    solver.solve()
